# Gate 1 package - BI-PF-1553
**Next-Gen Web Console Packaging Specification: embed pre-compiled SPA distribution assets into Go platform server binary**

## Plain language
**What/why:** Product Forge web console and dashboard assets must be securely bundled and served directly by the platform binary without shipping exposed web source files or running Node.js at runtime. -> Next-Gen Web Console Packaging Specification: embed pre-compiled SPA distribution assets into Go platform server binary.

## Gate 0 reconciliation + impact

## Gate 1.5 findings + architect recommendation
Gate 1.5 - Findings & Dispositions (model=mimo-v2.6-flash sha=455eef56422d)
**Overall architect recommendation: APPROVE**
Findings: 9 (BLOCKER 0 / MAJOR 4 / MINOR 3 / NIT 2); dispositions: actioned 9; all blockers/majors actioned
status: PENDING | ACTIONED | ACCEPTED | DEFERRED | REJECTED | SCOPE

| # | Severity | Finding | Disposition | Response / resolution |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | MAJOR | Startup attestation is fail-closed for the whole binary: one corrupted embedded asset prevents boot of APIs/health too, with no degraded mode, no precedence vs `PF_CONSOLE_STATIC_DIR`, and no alert lead-time (guardrails 2/4) — scope the failure to the console subsystem or state the operator recovery path. | ACTIONED | (no response yet) |
| 2 | MAJOR | Rollback path is not executable in the field: AC-3 packages ship only the binary, yet the external-dir rollback needs a verified console bundle on the host; design defines no source, integrity check, or restore procedure for it (guardrails 1/6). | ACTIONED | (no response yet) |
| 3 | MAJOR | `design_pack.tooling: False` contradicts DEC-1553-03's "build-time asset compilation is tooling" justification for `core/packaging.py:compile_web_console`; language-rule compliance (guardrail 7) is unresolvable until one authoritative classification is pinned. | ACTIONED | (no response yet) |
| 4 | MAJOR | Declared `go/web/console_test.go` has zero traceability/test_matrix entries; AC-2 proof rests on a single pipeline pytest whose relationship to the real Go handler (build+invoke vs reimplement) is unstated, leaving CL-001 single-writer/test-integrity unproven. | ACTIONED | (no response yet) |
| 5 | MINOR | EAP asset-bundle registration (`config/eap-registry.json`) has no version/skew contract: nothing states the embedded bundle version must match the platform/API version or that an external-dir bundle is version-checked before serving. | ACTIONED | (no response yet) |
| 6 | MINOR | No readiness/health signal distinguishes console-asset failure from API failure for operators (guardrail 2 alert lead-time); current observability is request logs plus packaging exit codes only. | ACTIONED | (no response yet) |
| 7 | MINOR | Route ownership/registration point of `ServeConsoleMux` inside the existing server mux is unspecified (CL-001 "register it"); design names the handler but not the owning mux or route-by-kind class. | ACTIONED | (no response yet) |
| 8 | NIT | `index.html` is `no-cache` but no revalidation mechanism (ETag/Last-Modified) is specified, forcing full re-download of the entry document on every navigation. | ACTIONED | (no response yet) |
| 9 | NIT | Gzip threshold/min-size is unstated, so small JSON/JS payloads pay compression latency without payload benefit against the sub-millisecond NFR. | ACTIONED | (no response yet) |

--- SUMMARY (review) ---
  Design is directionally sound (embed.FS, fail-closed IP guard, SPA/API route separation) but Gate 1.5 cannot approve: fail-closed startup blast radius, a rollback path that cannot run in the field, contradictory tooling/language-rule metadata, and missing Go-side test evidence must be resolved first.
  Per CL-006, all previously reported PENDING MAJORs must carry dispositions before approval; top risks are availability regression at boot and unproven AC-2 evidence.
=== 9 finding(s), 0 pending ===
